thread.title: Apple supply chain 'healthy and growing again,' says analyst

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple supply chain 'healthy and growing again,' says analyst
text: Cascend Securities analyst Eric Ross wrote Friday that Apple Inc.'s AAPL, +0.20% iPhone supply chain was "healthy and growing again." He said that it's too early in the iPhone production cycle for the supply chain to be fully ramped ahead of the new iPhone launch, but suppliers are "starting to build select parts." Ross wrote that some of the increased activity could also be due to a "slight restocking of iPhone X driven by better than expected sell-through." Ross rates Apple's stock a buy, and he has a $220 price target on the stock. Apple shares are up 27% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.78% has gained 14%.
